subject: BrightWave invoice intake setup and fallback plan
messages:
From: Lauren Andrews <andrews@brightwave.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightWave AP <ap@brightwave.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup + invoice delivery question

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the warm welcome last week. We're kicking off vendor setup for BrightWave and have a couple quick questions about invoicing. Attached is our completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf — please let me know if anything else is needed.

Main question: do you prefer we submit invoices via the Redwood AP portal or send them to ap@redwood.com by email? A few of our smaller recurring SOWs would be easier to send via email unless portal onboarding is required for PO matching/automated processing.

Also — can you confirm the required invoice fields so our team stamps POs correctly? We typically include: invoice#, invoice date, invoice total, line-item descriptions, and a PO number when applicable. If you have a sample template, that would help.

Thanks,

Lauren Andrews
Head of Finance Operations
BrightWave Analytics
andrews@brightwave.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 234KB)

From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Andrews <andrews@brightwave.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karl@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + invoice delivery question

Hi Lauren — great to hear from you and thanks for the completed form. Quick answers below and a couple of attachments to make onboarding smoother.

- Preferred path: portal is our canonical channel for invoices to enable automated PO matching and faster payments. That said, we support email fallback (ap@redwood.com) for low-volume suppliers while portal access is being arranged.
- Required fields for automated ingest: PO number (if applicable), invoice number, invoice date, line items with unit price and qty, bill-to and remit-to addresses. Our sample template includes a dedicated PO field and a simple two-column line-item layout.
- If you can indicate whether BrightWave will provide a single remit address or multiple, that helps our AP mapping.

I attached a sample_invoice_template.xlsx and the AP portal quickstart PDF to guide your team. For the small SOWs, feel free to email invoices while we provision your portal account; once live we recommend switching to portal-only for efficiency.

Next steps: I’ll loop in Marissa from AP to kick off portal provisioning and coord a light pilot (one month) where we validate PO stamping and remittance behavior.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

Attachments: sample_invoice_template.xlsx (Excel, 12KB), ap_portal_quickstart.pdf (PDF, 640KB)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Andrews <andrews@brightwave.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: ap-team@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + invoice delivery question

Hi Lauren —

I'll own the portal provisioning. Two operational notes for BrightWave's AP team:

1) Portal link & onboarding: https://portal.redwood.com/vendors/onboarding (use company code BW-4821). We will need the completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (we have Lauren's copy) and a copy of a voided check or remit letter to set up ACH.

2) Fallback email: ap@redwood.com. If you email invoices during onboarding, please include: 
   - Subject: Invoice | BrightWave | INV-<number> | PO-<number if present>
   - Attachments: single PDF preferred (one invoice per email)

3) PO stamping: we match on PO number first, then vendor tax ID + invoice number. If a PO is present, place it on the first line of the invoice and in the filename (e.g., INV-1234-PO-9876.pdf).

Marissa Cole
Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: ap_portal_quickstart.pdf (same as Jordan's), sample_invoice_template.xlsx (attached for convenience)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Andrews <andrews@brightwave.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + invoice delivery question

On Tue, May 11, 2027 at 11:20 AM marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> 3) PO stamping: we match on PO number first, then vendor tax ID + invoice number. If a PO is present, place it on the first line of the invoice and in the filename (e.g., INV-1234-PO-9876.pdf).

Just to add a technical note from procurement: when BrightWave submits via portal, we capture per-line metadata (product code, cost center) that helps downstream GL mapping. If you cannot include product codes from your side, we can fall back to a description-only mapping, but it slows matching.

Two quick asks for the pilot:
- Can BrightWave include a PO number on at least 70% of pilot invoices?
- Will you be able to include a cost center or job code on line items (optional but preferred)?

If email fallback is used, our parsing rules will still pull PO if present but may require manual review for missing metadata.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Lauren Andrews <andrews@brightwave.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + invoice delivery question

Thanks all — attaching an updated onboarding form (updated_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf) and a sample invoice that includes PO stamping (sample_invoice_v2.pdf).

Responses:
- We can include PO numbers on recurring SOW invoices and will aim for the 70% threshold for the pilot.
- Our billing system can add a single cost center field at the line level; we'll include that for the pilot invoices.
- Remittance: BrightWave prefers ACH to Bank of Redwood, remit@brightwave.com for remittance notifications. Please confirm the remit-to address you will use.
- For smaller invoices under $2k, we may send via email until portal access is fully operational.

Appreciate the quick help — let us know when the portal invites go out and any test invoice you want us to push through.

Best,
Lauren Andrews
Head of Finance Operations
BrightWave Analytics

Attachments: updated_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 198KB), sample_invoice_v2.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + invoice delivery question

Hi Lauren —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments. Plan below:

1) Portal provisioning: Marissa will send the vendor portal invite today (expect an email with temporary credentials). Please complete the portal registration and upload the voided check for ACH setup.
2) Pilot window: 2 weeks starting after you receive the invite. During that time, submit pilot invoices via portal for two SOWs and we will validate PO stamping and line-level cost center mapping.
3) Email fallback: approved for invoices <$2k during onboarding. Use Subject and filename format Marissa specified to expedite parsing.
4) Remit and payment terms: Redwood will remit to the remit-to you upload in the portal. Standard terms are Net 30; if you need Net 45 we can discuss but will need approval from Finance (I can open a request).

I added Mina from Ops in case we need to sample a parsed email to improve rules. If everything looks good after the pilot we'll switch to portal-only.

Next step: Marissa to send invites; Lauren to upload voided check and submit one test invoice (either via portal or email) so we can confirm mapping.

Thanks — looking forward to getting BrightWave live.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
